capabilities: split a note into one note per H2 heading
add parent links to split notes in frontmatter
rewrite the original note as a structure index of links
generate a MOC with a Mermaid flowchart knowledge map
preview detected sections before writing any files
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the repository includes a docs/ sample vault with five demo notes for trying the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically turn one long multi-section note into a set of linked sub-notes with an index and overview map.
summary: Note splitter that breaks a long note at H2 headings into separate notes with parent links, a structure index, a MOC, and a Mermaid knowledge map.
